full_judgment: 2. The brief fact relevant for disposal of this Rule is that the petitioner as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 151 of 2010 in the Court of the learned Assistant Judge, 4th Court, Narayangonj for cancellation of heba-bil-ewaz deed dated 5-8-1997 on the averments that the father of the plaintiff was the owner of the suit schedule land appertaining to CS Khatian No. 98, SA Khatian No. 449, RS Khatian No. 154, CS plot No. 266, SA plot No. 349, RS plot No. 531 by sale deed No. 1236 dated 3-2-1978, who died leaving one wife, two sons and two daughters. Plaintiff got 0.83 decimal lands by way of inheritance out of 5 decimals land. Plaintiff possessed the scheduled land by erecting house in taking electricity and gas connection. On 3-4-2010, the defendant asked the plaintiff to vacant the scheduled land with reference to heba-bil-ewaz deed dated 5-8-1997. Plaintiff after collecting the certified copy of the said deed had confirmed about the existence of heba-bil-ewaz deed and hence, the suit for the cancellation of deed.
